body:
**Tier:** T4 (abuse controls on user-generated content, cross-user visibility rules, membership removal (ban), one additive migration (enum values + nullable column), App Review 1.2 release blocker). Never lowered.
**Why:** Store-package review: community had no objectionable-content filter, no community-wide user blocking, ban/warn were recorded but not enforced, and the mobile review queue called `GET /community/moderation/flagged`, which did not exist. Apple 1.2 requires a filter, reporting with timely action, blocking and published contact information. Fix round 3 (lane B-UGC, agent 110) closes the Opus audit findings (B-610-1, C-610-1..4) and, per the owner decision of 20:32, makes **voice notes reportable in this PR directly so they can be ON at launch**, plus the member wins surface (More > Community) made safe instead of gated off (owner 20:38: more, not less).
**T4 trigger scan:**
- Authorization / visibility: two-way read-side block filter (`CommunitySafetyService.filterBlocked` / `assertVisibleTo` / `hiddenFromViewer`, one `UserBlock` lookup in both directions) on Hall posts, comments and replies, cohort messages, DMs, challenge comments + leaderboard, voice notes (list, by id, delete probe), cohort roster, workout leaderboard, wins, search, Today, reaction counts, coach-authored lessons, events and challenges. Reads by id answer 404. This round: the **blocker** gets `403 community.dm.blocked_by_you` with the way forward; the **blocked** member gets the same `404 community.dm.not_found` body as a missing conversation (the block is not revealed, C-610-1).
- Wins (B-610-1): audience is the author's coach circle only, and only when that coach runs a non-archived community workspace (that workspace's queue owns reports on the win); otherwise a member sees only their own wins. No cross-tenant feed (`visibility: 'public'` accepted for old clients, stored as `circle`). Removed (banned) members cannot post (`403 community.win.removed_member`) and their wins leave the feed. Hidden wins (`hidden_at`) never reappear. Author delete `DELETE /community/wins/:id` (anyone else gets the same 404 as a missing win).
- Voice notes: new report target `voice_note`; the coach queue gets a 15-minute signed playback link (`media`) for open reports on live notes, never for hidden/deleted notes. Only people who can play a note can report it (same 404 as missing). Hide / Warn / Ban work on voice notes; a ban removes the author's access. Author delete also soft-deletes the search row. DM voice notes are refused before any write (`400 community.voice.dm_not_supported`): there is no server-side DM thread binding, so they could not be moderated.
- Membership mutation: `ban` sets every membership of the author in that workspace to `removed`; if the author never joined a cohort, a `removed` membership is created in the default cohort so the ban also blocks wins. Workspace coach and platform owners can never be banned (`403 community.moderation.cannot_ban_coach`, now with a message); the check runs before any write.
- Migration `20270211000000_community_reports_voice_notes_and_wins`: `CommunityModerationTargetType` + `voice_note`, `win` (ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS, irreversible by nature, documented); `"CommunityWin"."hidden_at"` nullable, no default, no backfill. Two server-only tables (both ENABLE + FORCE RLS, service_role policy, RESTRICTIVE deny for anon/authenticated, no API-role grants): `community_workspace_bans` (round 2) and `community_voice_erasures` (round 5, section 6). `"CommunityWin"` RLS is rewritten in section 4 (round 2, tightened in round 5). down.sql drops the column, both tables and `app.community_win_author_coach`. Fix round 4 (C-610-4): section 5 widens `community_messages_scope_shape_check` so a scope `cohort` row may have no cohort only when it is a tagged post / challenge comment naming its parent (comments on Hall posts and workspace-wide challenges were rejected with 23514 and answered 500); down.sql restores the old check.
- **Round 5 (lane B-UGC-4):** a win's `coach_id` is bound to its author on INSERT (RLS `WITH CHECK` plus trigger, through the SECURITY DEFINER `app.community_win_author_coach`). Moderator authority on wins is only `is_current_coach_of(author)`; the `coach_id = me` arm is gone. The teammate helper also checks the author's coach. Moderation is escalation-only (dismiss < warn < hide < ban) and writes by compare-and-set. A weaker action gets `409 community.moderation.already_actioned`; a racing one gets `409 community.moderation.changed`. Member notices are keyed per (report, action). Voice-recording erasure is recorded durably before any soft delete, then retried every 10 minutes until storage confirms the object is gone. This covers author delete, moderation Hide/Ban and account deletion. Account deletion now stops finalization for the next run if the voice-note read or the erasure record fails; before, a failed read was logged and the rows stayed signable. The section 5 scope-shape CHECK arms are wrapped in `IS TRUE` and require `plan_context_type IS NOT NULL`.
- **Round 6 (lane B-UGC-6):** a moderation action is ONE database transaction: the compare-and-set resolution, the ban row and membership removal, the content soft-hide, the recording erasure intent and the member notice commit together or not at all (B-610-13). The coach/owner ban refusal stays a read-only check before the transaction; storage erasure, realtime and push run only after the commit. Recording erasure completes only on a verified object-level absence: the storage server's `Object not found` (body code 404/NoSuchKey, HTTP 400/404) for the exact key plus a confirmed bucket (`getBucket`); a generic 400, bucket-not-found, auth, 5xx, transport error or ambiguous not-found keeps the work open for the retry cron (B-610-8). The owner-folder check needs a confirmed bucket too (a missing bucket lists empty) and ignores the dashboard `.emptyFolderPlaceholder` (C-610-9). No route, payload, error code, migration, env name or CI gate change.
- **T4 gate file:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` gains one line: `test/community/rls/community-message-shape.live.spec.ts` in the community-live-tests jest list. No job, trigger, permission or required-check change.
- **Migration order:** `20270211000000` sorts before main's `20270216000000`. `prisma migrate deploy` applies every unapplied migration regardless of order. Forward migrations, reversibility and Schema parity are green on round 5 commits. No rename.
- Every queue item now carries `respond_by` (created + 24 h) and `overdue`, so the 24-hour commitment is visible and testable.
- Audio cannot be text-filtered: voice notes are not transcribed, so the word-list filter cannot run on them. Honest position: voice notes rely on report + moderation (reason sheet, coach + TGP review within 24 hours, Hide/Warn/Ban, two-way block, author delete). Win title and description go through the same text filter as posts (422 before the write).
**T3 (round 6):** no contract change for mobile #314: same routes, payloads and codes. A failed notice write now leaves nothing enforced (the endpoint already failed in that case). Posts/messages repositories gain an optional transaction client on `findById` / `softDelete` (backwards compatible).
**T3 (round 5):** new response codes `community.moderation.already_actioned` (409, carries `current_action`) and `community.moderation.changed` (409). `member_notice.stored` is true only when a notice for that action is stored; a replay answers `stored: true, push: 'not_sent'`. Mobile #314 maps both codes. New cron provider `VoiceErasureService` (`*/10 * * * *`, hardcoded, no new env name).
**T3 trigger scan:** contract changes this round (mobile #314 consumes them): flagged item `target_type` adds `voice_note` and `win`, plus `media` (`{ kind:'voice_note', url, duration_ms, mime_type } | null`), `removed`, `respond_by`, `overdue`; report body accepts `target_type: voice_note | win`; `GET /community/feed` rows carry `user_id, display_name, title, description, created_at, is_mine` (legacy `displayName, action, createdAt` kept); new `DELETE /community/wins/:id`; new codes `community.dm.blocked_by_you`, `community.win.not_found`, `community.win.removed_member`, `community.voice.dm_not_supported`; every voice error code now carries a human `message`. `CreateVoiceNoteDto.storage_key` is now validated: before this round the global whitelist pipe rejected every voice-note create with "property storage_key should not exist", so no member could publish a voice note at all.
**T3 (round 4):** `CommunityRealtimeService.broadcastCommunityEvent` now always removes its channel (also on subscribe timeout / send failure); no contract change.
**Bounded T1:** README Safety section (wins policy, voice-note reporting, which roles can be banned, the audio honesty note); doc comments on the wins routes.
**Builder/owner:** Claude Opus 5.5 (T4 builder). Round 2 (two-way block) built by lane B-COPY and supersedes agent 108's WIP branch `wip/op590e4a5b-copy-610-20261001` (1f4e158e); this round builds on that head (d1e1732f). Owner: operator. Needs two independent audits (GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5, neither the builder) plus green CI. Not self-audited.
**Acceptance evidence:** in-memory service suites below (the CI proof for these flows) + CI on the head SHA, including Schema parity. Device evidence owed by the device pass: record a voice note -> another member reports it -> coach queue plays it -> Hide removes it everywhere; block from a voice note hides both ways; share a win -> report -> Hide; banned member cannot share.
**Promotion triggers:** any route here losing `CommunityFeatureFlagGuard`/`JwtAuthGuard`; any path that lets a ban target the workspace coach; filtering moved after the write; block filtering removed from any listed surface or made one-way; a community GET route without a block-filter classification, or a classified handler that stops delegating to its asserted service method (wiring guard fails); `/community/moderation/flagged` returning workspaces the coach does not own; a playback link served for a hidden or deleted voice note; a wins feed that reaches outside the coach circle; any new table without RLS; any moderation enforcement or member-notice write moved outside the action transaction (round 6); erasure completing on anything but a verified object-level absence in a confirmed bucket (round 6). **Flags are not flipped by this PR**: `FEATURE_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES` stays as configured; the operator flips it after both audits + device pass.

**Dependencies:** OR-109-1 safety contact = the repo's one `SUPPORT_EMAIL` (`src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts`). #631 is now merged to main and merged into this branch, so `GET /community/safety` serves Bradleyapple1031@gmail.com; the retired `COMMUNITY_SAFETY_CONTACT_EMAIL` override is ignored (one address everywhere). Mobile #314 must merge with or after this PR.

## What was broken -> fixed
| Area | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Content filter | none (length checks/rate limits only) | word-list filter with normalisation on every community text write and on wins, 422 before the write |
| Blocking | coach-client messaging only | `UserBlock` honoured two-way on every member read and interaction path (list in README); DMs closed both ways; blocker told how to undo, blocked side sees "not available" |
| Ban | recorded only | removes the author's workspace memberships (creates a removed one when none) + hides the content; coach/owner protected |
| Warn | recorded only | notifies the author (community push), access kept |
| Mobile queue | `GET /community/moderation/flagged` 404 | implemented; voice notes play in the queue; 24-hour respond-by + overdue |
| Voice notes | not reportable, could not be created (DTO bug) | reportable, playable by the coach, hide/warn/ban, block parity, author delete, creatable |
| Wins | unfiltered, unreportable, global cross-tenant feed | filtered, reportable, coach-circle only, hide, ban, author delete |
| Contact | not in-app | `GET /community/safety` serves the repo's one `SUPPORT_EMAIL` |

## Known limits (documented in the README)
- Word-list filter, not a classifier; misses go through Report -> queue.
- **Audio cannot be text-filtered.** Voice notes are not transcribed; they rely on report + moderation (above). Stated plainly here and in the README.
- DM voice notes are refused (no server-side DM thread binding to moderate against).
- Realtime pings carry ids only; content is always refetched through the filtered REST routes.
- Reported DM content is visible to the workspace coach in the queue (the reporter chose to report it).
- The 24-hour commitment is operational (named moderators/cover); the queue now shows `respond_by`/`overdue`, it does not page anyone.
- List cursors come from the unfiltered page, so a page can be shorter than `limit` when blocked authors are dropped.
- C-610-4 (DB-backed proof of these flows) deferred, see fix-round table.
